title: Function module manifest
description: The manifest of one function module, at packages/naive/src/functions/<id>/function.json. A function module is one of the 13 functions in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json, as a folder: this manifest, the agent's instructions (agent.md), its workflows (workflows/<id>.json), its decision matrix (decisions.json), its skills and templates. What the manifest does not hold is derived, never typed twice: the record types the function owns come from the function field in data-model.json, its lead from the portfolios of the lead role templates, and its agent's write reach from the routes of the packages it owns. packages/naive/src/checks/check-functions.ts checks a module against all of it.

id.description: A departments.json id, the same as the folder's name.

purpose.description: What the function is for, in one plain sentence a founder reads.

intake.description: The id of the workflow the function's agent runs first in a venture: it asks the person only what the function's records are missing, most needed first.

measures.description: The telos measure kinds the function's work moves (foundation/telos measures[].kind), so a lead can weigh it.

clusters.description: The capability clusters (packages/naive/src/functions/it/capability-clusters.json ids) whose outside systems the function relies on. Empty when GitHub plus Naive is enough.
